answer: Continuous Presence Audit. Each agent must answer random low-latency challenges tied to its live sensor feed within a tight window; answers are checked against a signed device clock. A single operator cannot forge simultaneous real-time responses across many identities on hardware it doesn't control, and the tundra deployment proves the check holds under sparse connectivity. An attacker pays one physical device plus maintenance per identity, so mass registration fails because the orchard test caps valid responses per device.
